'''Anatol Odzijewicz''' (November 10, 1947 &ndash; April 18, 2022)<ref name="uwb">[https://www.uwb.edu.pl/nowosci/aktualnosci/nie-zyje-prof-dr-hab-anatol-odzijewicz/ad99371a Obituary on the webpage of University of Białystok]</ref><ref name="proceedings">{{cite book |last1=Kielanowski |first1=Piotr |last2=Dobrogowska |first2=Alina |last3=Goldin |first3=Gerald A. |last4=Goliński |first4=Tomasz |date=April 2023 |chapter=In Memoriam: Anatol Odzijewicz 1947–2022 |chapter-url=https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-30284-8_1 |title= Geometric Methods in Physics XXXIX, Workshop, Białystok, Poland, 2022 |publisher=Birkhauser |doi=10.1007/978-3-031-30284-8_1 | series= Conference proceedings |pages=1–4 |isbn=978-3-031-30283-1 }}</ref>[ was Polish [[mathematician]] and [[physicist]]. The main areas of his research were the theory of Banach [[Lie groupoid|groupoid]]s and [[Lie algebroid|algebroid]]s related to the structure of [[W*-algebra]]s, [[Quantization (physics)|quantization]] of physical systems by means of the [[coherent state]] map, as well as quantum and classical [[integrable systems]]. 

Anatol Odzijewicz was also a social activist. He founded a branch of the Society for the Preservation of Monuments in [[Białystok]] and chaired it for many years. He was the founder of the [[:pl:Skansen w Białowieży|open-air museum in Białowieża]].<ref name="proceedings"></ref><ref name="fb-chwaszczewski">[https://www.facebook.com/notes/342800810315571 History of Skansen by J. Chwaszczewski (in Polish)]</ref>

==Career==
In the years 1975-1979 Odzijewicz was employed at [[Warsaw University]]. Since 1979 Odzijewicz was working at [[University of Białystok]] (till 1997 it was a branch of Warsaw University). In the years 1997-2005 he was the dean of the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, and from 2008 to 2016 - the dean of the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science, [[University of Białystok]]. He was also the director of the Institute of Mathematics (2005-2008 and 2016-2019). He founded and was leading a group of researchers working in the area of [[mathematical physics]].<ref name="zfmat">[https://zfmat.uwb.edu.pl/staff.html Webpage of Department of Mathematical Physics, University of Białystok]</ref> 

He was also a founder and main organizer of the conference series [[Workshop on Geometric Methods in Physics]].<ref name="proceedings"></ref><ref name="wgmp">[https://wgmp.uwb.edu.pl/odzijewicz/ Obituary on the webpage of Workshop on Geometric Methods in Physics]</ref><ref name="ems">{{cite news |last1=Voronov |first1=Theodore |last2=Ali |first2=Syed Twareque |last3=Goliński |first3=Tomasz |date=March 2010 |title=The Białowieża Meetings on Geometric Methods in Physics: Thirty Years of Success and Inspiration |url=https://www.ems-ph.org/journals/newsletter/pdf/2010-03-75.pdf |work=[[European Mathematical Society]] Newsletter |number=75}}</ref>
